title: Peter Jennings' UFO special cut by 90%, followed by his death
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Peter Jennings' UFO special cut by 90%, followed by his death, about 2005 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they aired it but what they aired excluded 90% of the material.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, on the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, says that Peter Jennings, a famous American TV news anchor at the network ABC, made a television special about UFOs around 2005. According to Jorjani, it aired, but what was broadcast left out 90% of the material, and Jennings died not long after. If true, it would suggest that much of what he gathered was kept from the public.
